content.text: {v.win and 'A004 — YOU WIN!' or 'A004 — Push crates to goals'}
Arrows move  Enter reset  B back

scripts.move:
local v = ctx.v
local nx = v.px + v.dx
local ny = v.py + v.dy

local function isWall(x, y)
    if x < 0 or x > 7 or y < 0 or y > 7 then return true end
    if y == 0 or y == 7 then return true end
    if x == 0 or x == 7 then return true end
    if x == 2 and y == 2 then return true end
    if x == 3 and y == 2 then return true end
    if x == 4 and y == 2 then return true end
    if x == 5 and y == 3 then return true end
    if x == 1 and y == 4 then return true end
    if x == 2 and y == 4 then return true end
    if x == 3 and y == 5 then return true end
    if x == 5 and y == 6 then return true end
    if x == 6 and y == 6 then return true end
    return false
end

local nCellWall = isWall(nx, ny)
local nCellCrate1 = (nx == v.c1x and ny == v.c1y)
local nCellCrate2 = (nx == v.c2x and ny == v.c2y)

if not nCellWall then
    if nCellCrate1 then
        local nnx = nx + v.dx
        local nny = ny + v.dy
        if not isWall(nnx, nny) and not (nnx == v.c2x and nny == v.c2y) then
            v.c1x = nnx
            v.c1y = nny
            v.px = nx
            v.py = ny
        end
    elseif nCellCrate2 then
        local nnx = nx + v.dx
        local nny = ny + v.dy
        if not isWall(nnx, nny) and not (nnx == v.c1x and nny == v.c1y) then
            v.c2x = nnx
            v.c2y = nny
            v.px = nx
            v.py = ny
        end
    else
        v.px = nx
        v.py = ny
    end
end

local g1x, g1y = 3, 1
local g2x, g2y = 2, 5

local c1OnGoal = (v.c1x == g1x and v.c1y == g1y) or (v.c1x == g2x and v.c1y == g2y)
local c2OnGoal = (v.c2x == g1x and v.c2y == g1y) or (v.c2x == g2x and v.c2y == g2y)
v.win = c1OnGoal and c2OnGoal

local lines = {}
for y = 0, 7 do
    local row = ""
    for x = 0, 7 do
        if x == v.px and y == v.py then
            row = row .. "@"
        elseif x == v.c1x and y == v.c1y then
            row = row .. "O"
        elseif x == v.c2x and y == v.c2y then
            row = row .. "O"
        elseif isWall(x, y) then
            row = row .. "#"
        elseif (x == g1x and y == g1y) or (x == g2x and y == g2y) then
            row = row .. "."
        else
            row = row .. " "
        end
    end
    table.insert(lines, row)
end
v.boardText = table.concat(lines, "\n")
